front.title: Apple Begins Opening Siri AI to Developers
front.tldr: Starting with the iOS, iPadOS, macOS and visionOS 27.3 betas, Apple has opened a Developer Preview letting any developer integrate their app with Siri AI for the first time.

front.title: Orbital Matter 3D-printed the first rigid beam in the vacuum of space
front.tldr: Orbital Matter printed a rigid structural beam directly in orbit, an in-space construction first its makers say could enable building space data centres without launching pre-made parts.

front.title: Haas drops Ocon for rest of 2026 F1 season
front.tldr: Haas has permanently dropped Esteban Ocon for the remainder of the season. Formula 2 championship leader Rafael Camara will make his F1 debut at this weekend's Sao Paulo Grand Prix.

stories.title: Anthropic is working on a system to prove AI models' identity
stories.tldr: Anthropic is building FlashProve, a system that would let anyone check that an AI response genuinely came from the model it claims to be from.

stories.title: Netflix's new AI Discover tab helps you find something to watch based on your mood
stories.tldr: Netflix has launched an AI Discover tab for select US users, starting with one experimental feature that recommends titles based on what you're currently in the mood for.

stories.title: Data centers are turning to old jet engines as the wait for power grows
stories.tldr: Facing years-long waits for grid access and new turbines, data centre builders are turning to once-discarded jet engines as an unusual, less efficient stopgap for power.

stories.title: Qwen 3.8 27B on my laptop can interpret model weights, too
stories.tldr: Simon Willison found that Qwen 3.8 27B, running on his own laptop, can read and reason about another model's neural network weights, following a new paper on weight-space programming.

stories.title: CrowdStrike to pay nearly $500M for two AI security startups as the market for securing agents takes off
stories.tldr: CrowdStrike is buying Fiddler AI, which makes AI agent observability software, and Dreadnode, which automates AI security testing, for close to $500m combined.

stories.title: Ferrari's controversial Luce EV is sold out for 2027
stories.tldr: Ferrari's first electric car, the polarising Luce, is fully allocated through 2027, chief executive Benedetto Vigna said.

stories.title: What made Nothing's CMF Phone 2 Pro so much cheaper than others?
stories.tldr: Nothing's sister brand CMF made a series of deliberate design and component choices to keep the Phone 2 Pro's price well below rival phones.

stories.title: NVIDIA's controversial DLSS 5 is coming to RTX Remix to 'enhance' older games
stories.tldr: Nvidia's RTX Remix modding platform, which lets players remaster classic games with modern graphics, now includes its newer and more divisive DLSS 5 upscaling.

stories.title: Safari update brings vertical tabs, adaptive dark mode, AI integration
stories.tldr: The 27.3 developer betas bring major Safari updates due in December: a vertical tabs layout and an adaptive dark mode, among other changes.

stories.title: macOS 27.3 adds native Markdown rendering to Quick Look
stories.tldr: Starting with macOS 27.3, Quick Look can preview Markdown files with proper formatting directly, without opening another app.

stories.title: Xcode 27.3 adds GitHub Copilot to its built-in coding assistant
stories.tldr: Apple released Xcode 27.3 beta 1, expanding its built-in coding assistant to support GitHub Copilot alongside its existing options.

stories.title: Apple restricts dating apps and AI companions to users 18 and up
stories.tldr: Apple's new App Store rules will require an 18+ rating for dating apps and AI companions that offer sexual or romantic content.

stories.title: 'Dune 3' production designer created a 55-ton spaceship for the sci-fi epic
stories.tldr: Dune 3 production designer Patrice Vermette built a 55-tonne spaceship set piece for the final instalment of the trilogy, promising it will be 'a major spectacle'.

stories.title: Weta FX and TAICCA partner to turn Taiwan into an AI screen production hub for Asia
stories.tldr: Weta FX, the visual effects studio behind Lord of the Rings and Avatar, is partnering with Taiwan's creative content agency to build an AI screen production hub for Asia.

stories.title: The mad (color) science behind Rian Johnson's new camera app
stories.tldr: Cinematographer Steve Yedlin explains how he designed Chromagraph, a camera app built to make iPhone footage behave more cinematically through custom colour science.

stories.title: 'The Incomer' director Louis Paxton lands on BAFTA Breakthrough list, now working on a Plan B film
stories.tldr: Scottish writer-director Louis Paxton discusses his feature debut The Incomer, which drew Domhnall Gleeson and Moby and earned him a spot on BAFTA's Breakthrough list, as he develops a new film with Plan B.

stories.title: Rockets snap Celtics' five-game win streak, 109-93
stories.tldr: The Houston Rockets ended the Celtics' five-game winning streak 109-93 on the second night of a back-to-back, with Boston running out of gas in the second half.

stories.title: Celtics injury report reveals team could be without two stars vs. Bucks
stories.tldr: Jayson Tatum and Payton Pritchard are both questionable for Wednesday's game against the Bucks. Tatum has not missed a game all season.

stories.title: Joe Mazzulla explains why he uses AI to help him as Celtics coach
stories.tldr: Celtics coach Joe Mazzulla said using AI helps him test whether the processes he thinks are efficient actually are.

stories.title: What activating Marcus Bryant and releasing Kindle Vildor means for the Patriots
stories.tldr: The Patriots activated tackle Marcus Bryant from injured reserve and released cornerback Kindle Vildor, continuing a busy week of roster moves.

stories.title: What Patriots are looking for in a potential Christian Barmore trade
stories.tldr: With the NFL trade deadline on 10 November approaching, defensive tackle Christian Barmore is one Patriot being watched for a possible move.

stories.title: Tom Brady expects an 'emotional' return to Gillette Stadium on Sunday for Patriots vs. Packers
stories.tldr: Tom Brady said he expects an emotional return to Gillette Stadium on Sunday, when he will broadcast the Patriots-Packers game for Fox Sports.

stories.title: Red Bull's key strategy call behind Verstappen's Mexico win
stories.tldr: Red Bull's strategy call played a key role in Max Verstappen's win at the Mexico City Grand Prix, even as the weekend's biggest storyline was Kimi Antonelli's title.

stories.title: Charles Leclerc brushes off Lewis Hamilton clash: 'I could be unhappy too'
stories.tldr: Charles Leclerc played down his lap-one clash with Ferrari team-mate Lewis Hamilton at the Mexico City Grand Prix, where the pair traded aggressive blows battling for the race lead.

stories.title: Mercedes boss praises Antonelli's masterclass while admitting they failed George Russell
stories.tldr: Toto Wolff said Mercedes successfully crowned the youngest world champion in F1 history in Kimi Antonelli, while also acknowledging the team let down team-mate George Russell.

stories.title: Red Sox News & Links: Sox trade Eduardo Rivera to Cardinals, DFA Zack Kelly
stories.tldr: The Red Sox traded reliever Eduardo Rivera to the Cardinals and designated reliever Zack Kelly for assignment as they trimmed the roster to 40 players.

stories.title: Tracy, Tolle seeking hardware as finalists for BBWAA Awards
stories.tldr: Red Sox pair Chad Tracy and Payton Tolle are finalists for BBWAA awards recognising the best performers of the 2026 season.

stories.title: 5 takeaways from the Red Sox' offseason so far, including Gold Gloves, trades, and more
stories.tldr: Wilyer Abreu, Ceddanne Rafaela and Caleb Durbin were recognised for their defensive play as Gold Glove winners, among several moves in the Red Sox' early offseason.

finally.title: Holst completes Adjaye-designed mass-timber library in Oregon
finally.tldr: US studio Holst has completed a mass-timber library in Oregon, taking over a project originally designed by Adjaye Associates, with tall entrance columns and a central atrium.
